Project Description ( VR-125129)
 Join our Development Centre in Bucharest and become a member of our open-minded, progressive and professional team. In this role you will be working on projects for one our world famous clients. You will have a chance to grow your technical and soft skills, and build a thorough expertise of the industry of our client. On top of attractive salary and benefits package, Luxoft will invest into your professional training, and allow you to grow your professional career.
 The project aims to develop an integrated application covering the end-to-end credit risk workflow.
 Responsibilities 
 o Able to cope with hybrid way of working - 3 days/week from client's office in Bucharest Pipera.
 o Work with stakeholders to identify and capture test automation and tooling needs
 o Actively participate in the development and maintenance of test automation frameworks
 o Design, develop and maintain automated test scripts
 o Closely work with the extended Engineering team to ensure a high automation level across processes
 o Analyze system requirements alongside QA Engineers and define automation scope
 o Perform test automation executions, identify failures' root cause and compile reports to stakeholders
 o Adheres to test automation best practices as defined at organization level
 o Drive automation-focused test strategy
 Mandatory Skills Description 
 Minimum 3 years of experience with QA automation
 Python
 SQL (Oracle)
 Languages 
 English: B2 Upper Intermediate
